# 💰 Chapter 1: Money Foundations

::: info 🎯 In this chapter
Inflation, compounding, risk and where money can go.
:::

## Units in this chapter

1. [Why Money Loses Value](/money-foundations/1.1-why-money-loses-value) - Learn why ₹100 today buys less tomorrow, and how inflation, CPI and real returns work.
2. [Compounding and Time Value of Money](/money-foundations/1.2-compounding-and-time-value-of-money) - How compound interest, the rule of 72 and time value of money explain why starting early wins.
3. [Risk and Return](/money-foundations/1.3-risk-and-return) - Understand market, inflation, credit and liquidity risk, volatility, and the risk-return trade-off.
4. [Where Money Can Go](/money-foundations/1.4-where-money-can-go) - Compare bank FDs, PPF/EPF, gold, debt, equity and real estate on safety, liquidity and return.

::: tip 📖 How to read
Go in order. Every new term is explained the first time it appears, and each unit ends with a keywords table.
:::
